anti_cross_contamination: No shared competitor cohorts, trend baselines, voice identity, retention data or creative canons across branches.

authority.CINE: market research, niche strategy, original script and editorial governance
authority.YouTube: owner OAuth actions only, never by installation

branches.angle: Documented daily-life details over sensational history; uncertainty is explained, never filled with fabricated scenes as facts.
branches.audience: English-speaking adults 30-70+ in US/UK who enjoy calm social history at bedtime
branches.graphics: Licensed archival materials, historically labeled reconstructions, original maps; no false period footage.
kpi: D7/D14/D30 views measured at equal video ages
first-30s retention and absolute watch minutes
branches.name: Everyday History for Sleep
branches.promise: Well-sourced ordinary lives, work, homes, and objects from history, narrated calmly without unsupported certainty.
branches.sound: Low-arousal human-sounding narration; no abrupt transient, graphic war detail, heavy music or clickbait promise.
source_rules: 2 independent authoritative sources for key claims wherever possible
separate primary records, scholarship and speculation
no invented quotes, diary entries or intimate thoughts presented as fact

branches.angle: Real agency for senior characters; emotionally honest, not interchangeable revenge templates.
branches.audience: English-speaking adults 45-75+ interested in relatable family conflict and resilient older protagonists
branches.graphics: Original 16:9 cinematic illustrations with continuity and licensed textures only; do not imply true stories.
kpi: D7/D14/D30 views measured at equal ages
repeat viewers and title-to-story promise match
branches.name: Original Senior Family Drama & Quiet Justice
branches.promise: Original mature-family emotional stories: dignity, choices, credible consequences and earned justice.
branches.sound: Readable US/UK English, differentiated voices for actual speakers, empathetic pace and legally-cleared score.
source_rules: Reddit/Goodreads only as abstract unmet-needs research, never retell posts
independent original plot DNA, characters, dialogue and causal structure
no competitor premises, names, twists, dialogue or expression adapted

branches.angle: Visualizing scale and uncertainty with quiet scientific curiosity; no fabricated discoveries.
branches.audience: English-speaking curious adults 25-65+ in US/UK seeking calm astronomical explanations
branches.graphics: Rights-cleared NASA/ESA/media with individual license checks; original illustrative animations, not fake telescope data.
branches.name: Space Science & Nature for Sleep
branches.promise: Wonder-filled but accurate, source-checked space and science journeys that support restful listening.
branches.sound: Gentle steady loudness, coherent low-stimulation voice, no abrupt effects or unsupported sleep therapy claims.
source_rules: NASA/ESA/observatory or original research sources for central claims
units, numerical values and dates checked against sources
separate observational facts from hypotheses; no health/sleep medical claims
